messages:
maya: CI is red on main — lots of failures in test-db-seed job, looks like the seed container is exiting mid-run :confused:
ci-bot: build: https://ci.internal/redwood/3578 job: test-db-seed (failed) — exit code 137
ryan: can you paste the failing log? i’ll kick a rerun if it’s transient
maya: log snippet:
```
Seeding database...
ERROR: connection to postgres://localhost:5432 failed: Connection refused
Seed process exited with status 1
Container logs show: OOM killer invoked, pid=1345, killed process 1342 (seed)
```
sasha: saw similar yesterday when runners hit disk pressure — container started swapping and OOMed. which runner pool did this job run on?
leo: this one ran on shared-ci-2 (aws eu-west-1). that pool had a big k8s evict event earlier, cleaned up now but need to check node resources.
ryan: i'll rerun the job `ci retry 3578` — if it's a transient node issue it should pass
ci-bot: rerun queued (build 3579)
maya: also, a bunch of tests that depend on deterministic seed started flaking after the test-harness change last week (see PR #1123) — might be two unrelated failures colliding
sasha: good point. PR #1123 changed how seed is generated (more entropy). if seeding fails due to OOM, tests fail non-deterministically. suggest adding guard: retry seed up to 3x with backoff and log memory stats
leo: short-term: increase container memory limit for seed job in ci-config to 2GiB, add swap disabled. long-term: pin seed for unit tests or run them on dedicated runners
ryan: rerun finished: build 3579 — one failure remains in test-db-seed (flaky), others passed
maya: can someone bisect to see if PR #1123 correlates? i can do a bisection but need a green baseline
ryan: i’ll do a quick git bisect on the harness branch, focus on the seed change window
ryan: quick note: when I ran locally the seed job hit high RSS ~1.8G before OOM. reproduces with the new harness
leo: i've opened a short incident to track runner resource pressure: INC-2026-78 — linked in the oncall dashboard https://ops.internal/inc/INC-2026-78
oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-78 created by leo — assigned to eng-infra oncall
sasha: pushed a tiny fix to ci-config: clamp seed entropy and add 3x retry with 2s backoff. also bumped seed container mem to 2G in shared-ci-2 pool — rollout in progress
maya: thanks. can we also add a one-line note in PR template to run `./dev/ci-local seed` locally if touching harness? saves cycles
ryan: bisect result: culprit commit is 9f4a2b6 (PR #1123). reverting or adding seed retry fixes local reproduce. will open PR to refine seeding and reduce memory use
ci-bot: build 3580 (post-rollout) — test-db-seed PASSED ✅
maya: great — closing this thread. follow-up: we'll keep incident open until we confirm no further evictions on shared-ci-2 for 24h
leo: noted, adding a shortwatch on the nodes and setting automated alerts for evaporation rate > 1/hour
ryan: follow-up todo: PR to reduce memory footprint of seeding script (estimate: 2d)
sasha: will add the PR and link to INC-2026-78
maya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
